items.name: Breasal's Thorn Brooch
items.lore: Won from Breasal of the Thorns at the Hollow Road. The thorns are real, and sharp.

items.name: Dubhan's Bridle-Ring
items.lore: A ring from Rider-Captain Dubhan's bridle, won at the Ford of Sorrows. It never gets wet.

items.name: Bronach's Hag-Stone
items.lore: Hag-Mother Bronach's own stone, won in the Hag-Wood. Through the hole, nothing is lovely.

items.name: Thorn Knight's Bracer
items.lore: Black thorn and iron, won from the Thorn Knight at the Thorn Gate.

items.name: Cliodna's Thorn Torc
items.lore: Won at the Queen's Seat. Cliodna wore it as an elf, a hag and a bainshee, and it fitted every one.

items.name: Bainshee Queen's Veil
items.lore: Pale green, like scale. When the wind gets in it, it keens.

items.name: Mantle of the Host
items.lore: King Lug's green, given to those who stood at the Queen's Seat. Only the Host's quartermaster has them.

items.name: Lamfhota's Spear Torc
items.lore: A torc shaped like Lug's long spear, the Areadbhair. It's warm to the touch.

items.name: Seat-Breaker's Belt
items.lore: Studded with chips of the Queen's white stones.

items.name: Ring of the Long Arm
items.lore: Lug of the Long Arm reaches far. So does whoever wears this.

items.name: Bracer of the Thorn Gate
items.lore: The Host's bracer, for the ones who held the Thorn Gate.

items.name: Fogless Jewel
items.lore: A clear stone from the forest floor, found the morning the fog lifted.
